providers.title: Closure basics
providers.scope: Closure is monotone, bases span, and a maximal independent subset of Y spans Y.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Direct sums of infinite matroids
providers.scope: A direct sum of matroids is a matroid; bases and closures are componentwise; self-duality is inherited.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Self-dual reduction (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For self-dual matroids whose spanning sets contain bases, a packing/covering partition gives an independent covering.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Independent columns
providers.scope: Continuum many subsets of D whose finite membership patterns have exact proportion 2^-r in late blocks.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ultrafilter extension
providers.scope: Every family with the finite intersection property lies in an ultrafilter (by transfinite recursion).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An ultrafilter avoiding the larger ideal (OpenAI)
providers.scope: An ultrafilter disjoint from K, containing every G_t, each member K-contained in only finitely many G_t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Raising the ordinal rank (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Between a small set and a large set there are large sets of arbitrarily high ordinal rank.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Simultaneous reservations (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For fewer than continuum many positive sets, one index gives two disjoint K-small sets meeting all of them positively.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local bases: antichains and exchanges
providers.scope: The local basis families are antichains closed under balanced finite exchanges.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Interpolation (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Between a set with lower limit at most -1 and one with positive lower limit lies a local basis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Interval alternatives (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For intervals near the class, some local basis lies below, between, or above the endpoints.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The basis family (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A complement-closed antichain of admissible sets, closed under balanced exchanges, meeting every interval with infinite gap.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A self-dual matroid with an ordinal inequality (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A self-dual matroid Q on a countable set whose bases satisfy rho(B_L) > rho(D minus B_R) when B_L is large.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniformity of Q
providers.scope: Every subset is independent or contains a basis; finite sets are independent; spanning sets of restrictions contain maximal independent sets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spanning property of the pair
providers.scope: In the two direct sums along the double ray, spanning sets of restrictions contain maximal independent subsets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Packing/covering fails for infinite matroids (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Two self-dual matroids on a countable set have no independent covering and no packing/covering partition.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Self-dual uniform matroids in ZFC (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A countable self-dual matroid with every subset independent or spanning and infinite bases and cobases exists in ZFC.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Controlled basis extension
providers.scope: Independent A and basis D extend to a basis contained in A union D.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Dual matroid and double dual
providers.scope: All independence axioms, including maximal extension on arbitrary subsets; no finitary hypothesis.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Complementary maximality
providers.scope: Maximality of the inside part of a basis is equivalent to dual maximality of its outside complement.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Restriction and contraction matroids
providers.scope: Both operations yield matroids on every selected subset.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Contraction bases and independent gluing
providers.scope: Basis extension through contraction and gluing to every independent set on the complementary ground set.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Closure equality and spanning bases
providers.scope: A basis of a subset has its closure; every spanning set contains a basis; restriction closure identity.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Spanning/independence duality
providers.scope: Complement identities for restrictions and contractions with the ground set explicit.
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Intersection and packing/covering
providers.scope: Explicit witnesses in both directions for arbitrary infinite matroids M,N: intersection(M,N) iff packing/covering(M,N*).
providers.status: Author self-check; no independent review or formal verification

providers.title: Closure and minor ground sets
providers.scope: Idempotent closure, enlarged contraction independence, restriction/contraction identity and spanning gluing.
providers.status: Author self-check; not independent mathematical review or formal verification.

providers.title: Greatest wave support
providers.scope: Arbitrary set-indexed families; transfinite closure argument, not a union of independent sets.
providers.status: Author self-check; not independent mathematical review or formal verification.

providers.title: Family-to-pair encoding
providers.scope: Explicit Cartesian coordinates, row matroids and both witness constructions, including nonexhaustive packings and overlapping covers.
providers.status: Author self-check; not independent mathematical review or formal verification.

providers.title: Five universal equivalences
providers.scope: Pairwise intersection, pairwise and family packing/covering, separate covering and packing conditions; all implications, no finite or countability restriction.
providers.status: Author self-check; not independent mathematical review or formal verification.
